Hence the clean energy blockade, creating a huge money pump, extracting money from electricity ratepayers, and sending it to Trump’s corrupt fossil fuel donors. Think that’s coincidence?

They’ve noticed that when they block clean energy, the grid has to go up the “generation stack” to their expensive units. 

Customers pay a lot more for their expensive energy, but the extra billions customers pay ends up in their own pockets.
Crooked fossil fuel interests noticed, because ratepayers saving money meant them losing money, so they’ve been using their influence over Trump to block low-cost energy.
You can see that at demand levels of 68 GW, the electricity cost on the Texas grid was only a third of what it was before the low-cost clean energy surge. That’s big ratepayer savings.
After the surge of low-cost clean energy, the Texas demand/cost curve looked like this.
From August 2018 to August 2024, low-cost clean energy surged on to the Texas grid; solar, wind, and battery added 17.6 GW additional power.
